verdict.rationale: Smooth documents agent-facing integration paths, but no framework adapters. There are dedicated CLI guides for Claude Code and OpenClaw, a generic "works with any agent that can run CLI commands" path, and a REST API/SDK that any framework could wrap. None of the evidence shows documented adapters for the Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK, LangChain or CrewAI, so framework integration falls to the developer. Missing for 10: documented adapters/packages for Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK, LangChain and CrewAI, framework-specific integration examples, independent corroboration of framework usage.
